purpose: Extend the existing PR78 logged-token measurement through the latest complete Central date without creating a second cost pipeline or treating list-price estimates as billing.

source.coverage_statement: logged requests only; missing days are not zero; October 28 is partial and excluded

method.baseline: Sum the six camera:* groups on 2026-10-08.
method.comparison: Sum the same six camera:* groups on each complete date 2026-10-09 through 2026-10-27.
method.token_accounting: Use input_tokens and output_tokens once; cached input is a subset of input and reasoning output is a subset of output, so neither is added again.
exclusions: request counts as proof of accepted cycles

observed_change.interpretation: Observational logged-token change across different scenes and dates; not causal compact-JSON savings, not actual billing, and not proof of equivalent biological detection.

operational_cross_check.limitation: One six-camera capture passed local/R2 archive recovery, but this does not establish accepted-cycle counts for all 19 days or biological detection equivalence.

detection_equivalence.note: The October 27 archive receipt proves current raw-frame recoverability for one capture; it does not supply a pre-change output or independent biological truth.

guardrails: Missing usage days are unknown, not zero.
Failures and missed coverage are not savings.
Different scenes do not establish causal savings.
Logged tokens and conditional list prices do not establish billed charges.
No paid replay, capture, model, image-detail, cadence, coverage, threshold, or wind-optimization change was made.
